title: Code 430 tone mode v0
description: One tone mode: the maximum level per content descriptor, mechanic flags and the variant key content items use. Base modes live in game/core/content/modes/.

outcomes.description: How systems resolve things in this mode, so gameplay code never branches on a mode id.

ambulance.description: What paramedics do once they have tended a downed person: they get up, are carried off on a stretcher, or are lifted away by a drone.

officer.description: What happens to a police officer the player has beaten (add-police-combat): knocked down until the chase ends, or tagged out (sits with hands up, then walks back to the car). A mode without violence never knocks down.

accent.description: The HUD accent: the chosen segment of the weapon wheel and the idle tile's flash.
